_comment: Dev-server API proxy for `npm start` (ng serve on :4200). Routes the app's relative /api calls (and static/media/admin/ws) to the running prod stack, which serves HTTPS on localhost (nginx -> Django). secure:false accepts the stack's self-signed cert. Session cookies are host-scoped (localhost), so login on :4200 carries to the proxied backend. HOST dev-tooling only; does NOT add a frontend service to docker-compose.
